name: Uplengen (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of black, white and black, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Uplengen (a black eagle above a red castle between stars on white).
history: Municipal flag of Uplengen; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Uplengen arms — eagle and castle on white
